document_api_meta.title: Create FBT Goods
document_api_meta.env_desc:
Create FBT goods records and link each record to a TikTok Shop SKU. Request-level errors can be returned before per-item results are populated. When `create_result_info.create_result_list` contains entries, correlate them by `tts_sku_id`, check `is_success` for each returned item, read `fail_reason` for failures, and use `tts_goods_id` for successes.

The request supports dimensions and weight, return handling, hazardous-material, shelf-life, SIOC, bulky-item, and safety attributes.

request_header_param.name: x-tts-access-token
request_header_param.desc: The seller access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 0. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a344ddec3030b238fa0) to get seller access_token.

request_query_param.name: app_key
request_query_param.desc: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

request_query_param.name: sign
request_query_param.desc: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

request_query_param.name: timestamp
request_query_param.desc: Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

request_query_param.name: shop_cipher
request_query_param.desc:
Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response. 
Get by API [Get Authorization Shop](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9?external_id=6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9)

request_body_param.name: create_goods_dto_list
request_body_param.desc: List of goods records to create.

request_body_param.name: ^tts_sku_id
request_body_param.desc: Identifier for Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) generated by TikTok Shop system

request_body_param.name: ^create_goods_type
request_body_param.desc: Type of create-goods operation. Current supported value: CREATE_AND_BIND.

request_body_param.name: ^goods_name
request_body_param.desc: Name of the goods. Maximum length: 255 characters.

request_body_param.name: ^goods_image_url
request_body_param.desc: Image URL for the goods.

request_body_param.name: ^reference_code
request_body_param.desc: Reference code for the goods. Maximum length: 50 characters.

request_body_param.name: ^barcode_infos
request_body_param.desc: Barcodes for the goods. For each goods record, provide at most one UPC, EAN, or GTIN in total, at most five ASIN_OR_FNSKU values, and at most five MERCHANT_SKU_ID values.

request_body_param.name: ^^barcode_type
request_body_param.desc: Type of barcode provided for the goods, such as UPC.

request_body_param.name: ^^barcode_value
request_body_param.desc: Barcode value. UPC must contain 8 or 12 digits; EAN must contain 8 or 13 digits; and GTIN must contain 8, 12, 13, or 14 digits. UPC, EAN, and GTIN values must have a valid checksum. ASIN_OR_FNSKU must contain 10 uppercase letters or digits and start with B or X. MERCHANT_SKU_ID must contain 1 to 32 printable ASCII characters with no whitespace.

request_body_param.name: ^return_handling_method
request_body_param.desc:
Return handling method for the FBT customer return service. The default value will be Restock sellable, Dispose unsellable.
Possible values:
- COLLECT_RETURN_UNITS
- RESTOCK_SELLABLE_COLLECT_UNSELLABLE
- RESTOCK_SELLABLE_DISPOSE_UNSELLABLE
- DISPOSAL_WITHOUT_INSPECTION
- RETURN_WITHOUT_INSPECTION
- RESTOCK_SELLABLE_RETURN_UNSELLABLE

request_body_param.name: ^dimension_and_weight_base_info
request_body_param.desc: Dimensions and weight for the goods. weight_value, length_value, width_value, and height_value must each be a numeric string greater than 0.

request_body_param.name: ^^weight_value
request_body_param.desc: Weight of the goods in the specified weight_unit.

request_body_param.name: ^^length_value
request_body_param.desc: Length of the goods in the specified dimension_unit.

request_body_param.name: ^^width_value
request_body_param.desc: Width of the goods in the specified dimension_unit.

request_body_param.name: ^^height_value
request_body_param.desc: Height of the goods in the specified dimension_unit.

request_body_param.name: ^^weight_unit
request_body_param.desc: Weight unit. Possible values: MILLIGRAM (mg), GRAM (g), KILOGRAM (kg), POUND (lb), OUNCE (oz).

request_body_param.name: ^^dimension_unit
request_body_param.desc: Dimension unit. Possible values: MILLIMETER (mm), CENTIMETER (cm), METER (m), FOOT (ft), INCH (in).

request_body_param.name: ^is_hazmat
request_body_param.desc: whether is hazmat goods

request_body_param.name: ^hazmat_info
request_body_param.desc: Hazardous-material details. Required when is_hazmat is true. For hazmat_type BATTERY, FLAMMABLE_LIQUID, or AEROSOLS, provide battery_extra_info, flammable_liquids_extra_info, or aerosol_extra_info, respectively.

request_body_param.name: ^^hazmat_type
request_body_param.desc:
hazardous goods type
Possible values:
-MAGNETIZED
-BATTERY 
-FLAMMABLE_LIQUID
-AEROSOLS

request_body_param.name: ^^battery_extra_info
request_body_param.desc: Battery details for goods with hazmat_type set to BATTERY. total_battery_weight must be greater than 0. When battery_packaging_type is STANDALONE, battery_count_per_package must be greater than 0. When is_need_un_38_3_test is true, provide un_38_3_test_file_url.

request_body_param.name: ^^^battery_type
request_body_param.desc:
Battery type
Possible values:
LITHIUM_ION
LITHIUM_METAL
OTHER

request_body_param.name: ^^^battery_packaging_type
request_body_param.desc:
Battery packaging type.
Possible values:
- STANDALONE
- IN_EQUIPMENT
- WITH_EQUIPMENT
- OTHER

request_body_param.name: ^^^total_battery_weight
request_body_param.desc: Total battery weight in the unit specified by total_battery_weight_unit.

request_body_param.name: ^^^total_battery_weight_unit
request_body_param.desc: Unit for total_battery_weight. Possible value: GRAM.

request_body_param.name: ^^^total_battery_capacity
request_body_param.desc: Total battery capacity in the unit specified by total_battery_capacity_unit.

request_body_param.name: ^^^total_battery_capacity_unit
request_body_param.desc: Unit for total_battery_capacity, such as WATTHOUR.

request_body_param.name: ^^^is_need_un_38_3_test
request_body_param.desc: UN38.3 testing ensures that batteries meet specific safety criteria. Please send the report in the field if it's not included in the MSDS.

request_body_param.name: ^^^un_38_3_test_file_url
request_body_param.desc: UN38.3 testing file URL

request_body_param.name: ^^^battery_count_per_package
request_body_param.desc: per package battery count

request_body_param.name: ^^flammable_liquids_extra_info
request_body_param.desc: Flammable-liquid details for goods with hazmat_type set to FLAMMABLE_LIQUID. flammable_liquids_volume must be a numeric string greater than 0.

request_body_param.name: ^^^flammable_liquids_type
request_body_param.desc:
Flammable-liquid type.
Possible values:
- PAINT
- PERFUMERY
- ALCOHOLIC
- OTHER

request_body_param.name: ^^^flammable_liquids_volume
request_body_param.desc: Volume of flammable liquid in the unit specified by volume_unit.

request_body_param.name: ^^^volume_unit
request_body_param.desc: Unit for flammable_liquids_volume, such as MILLILITERS.

request_body_param.name: ^^dg_class
request_body_param.desc:
Hazmat class
Possible values:
-CLASS_2
-CLASS_3
-CLASS_9

request_body_param.name: ^^dg_uncode
request_body_param.desc:
UN identifier for the hazardous substance. Standard UN values use the `UN` prefix followed by four digits; `OTHER` is also supported.
Possible values:
- UN2807
- UN3480
- UN3090
- UN3481
- UN3091
- UN1263
- UN1266
- UN3065
- OTHER

request_body_param.name: ^^msds_file_url
request_body_param.desc: Material safety data sheet of the hazmat goods to support review the goods' safety compliance in FBT

request_body_param.name: ^^aerosol_extra_info
request_body_param.desc: Aerosol info

request_body_param.name: ^^^volume
request_body_param.desc: Aerosol volume. Required when `hazmat_type` is `AEROSOLS`. The value must be a numeric string greater than 0.

request_body_param.name: ^^^volume_unit
request_body_param.desc: aeroslo volume unit

request_body_param.name: ^is_lot_code
request_body_param.desc: Whether lot-code management is enabled for the goods.

request_body_param.name: ^is_expiration_management
request_body_param.desc: Whether shelf-life management is enabled for the goods. When true, shelf_life_attribute_info is required.

request_body_param.name: ^shelf_life_attribute_info
request_body_param.desc: Shelf-life attributes for the goods. The cutoff values must be nonnegative and satisfy sales_cutoff_days < expiration_alert_days < inbound_cutoff_days. If provided, shelf_life must be less than 3650 days.

request_body_param.name: ^^shelf_life
request_body_param.desc: The goods shelf life (days)

request_body_param.name: ^^inbound_cutoff_days
request_body_param.desc: The goods inbound cutoff days before expiration, represent the time period before the product's expiration when the warehouse will no longer accept inbound shipments.

request_body_param.name: ^^expiration_alert_days
request_body_param.desc: The goods alert days before expired, represent the period of time before platform send expiration reminder alerts to the merchant.

request_body_param.name: ^^sales_cutoff_days
request_body_param.desc: The goods sales cut off days before expired, represent the period of time before expiration in which the goods will no longer be available for sale.

request_body_param.name: ^^handling_method_expired_goods
request_body_param.desc:
How expired inventory is handled.
Possible values:
- `STORE_UNITS`: Move the units to defective inventory.
- `RETURN_TO_SELLER`: Return the units to the seller.
- `DISPOSE`: Dispose of the units.

request_body_param.name: ^is_sioc

request_body_param.desc: sioc info

request_body_param.desc:
sioc attachment type:

request_body_param.name: ^bulky_item_attribute

request_body_param.name: ^^is_bulky_item_accessories
request_body_param.desc: whether the goods is bulky accessories

request_body_param.name: ^goods_safety_attributes
request_body_param.desc: safety attribute info

request_body_param.name: ^^is_fragile
request_body_param.desc: where fragile

request_body_param.name: ^^is_liquid
request_body_param.desc: Whether the goods are liquid.

request_body_param.name: ^^is_sharp
request_body_param.desc: where sharp

response_param.name: code
response_param.desc: The success or failure status code returned in API response.

response_param.name: message
response_param.desc: The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.

response_param.name: ^^^tts_sku_id
response_param.desc: Identifier for the SKU generated by TikTok Shop system.

response_param.desc: Identifier of the FBT goods record. Returned when is_success is true.
